title: Understanding Target Probability Reuse in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. translated_title: 理解投机解码中的目标概率复用
translated_abstract: 投机解码使用目标模型并行验证一棵草稿token树。我们研究由此产生的下一个token分布是否有助于选择下一棵树。对于无限制的目标模型，我们证明了保证精确复用需要在下一轮完整上下文中计算的分布。我们刻画了何时保留该分布需要牺牲已被接受的token，并建立了这种损失在解码轮次间持续存在的条件。在六个目标模型的实验中，我们发现使用在当前上下文中单独计算的分布对首token分支进行重排序，相比草稿排序能够提高期望接受率，尤其是在树预算较小的情况下。在分配树之前先从该分布中抽取首token，相比对预先选择的树进行剪枝能进一步提高期望接受率，即使平均树大小相同。在我们的实验中，当……时，这两种选择规则的解码速度也比草稿排序更快。
tldr: 该论文系统研究了投机解码中目标模型下一个token分布的复用问题，证明了精确复用需要下一轮完整上下文中的分布，并提出用当前上下文单独计算的分布重排首token分支或先抽取首token再分配树，从而提高期望接受率并加快解码速度。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies the reuse of the target model's next-token distributions in speculative decoding, proves that exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context, and shows that reranking first-token branches or drawing the first token before tree allocation using a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance and decoding speed.
